newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Bus strike cripples transport in Guatemala City.
newsitem.headline: Bus strike cripples transport in Guatemala City.

text.p: Guatemala City bus companies froze public transport in the capital on Tuesday, calling a stoppage after authorities refused to permit fare hikes.
The stoppage began in the morning and kept virtually all 3,000 buses in Guatemala City off the road.

"We must have a rate hike because the impact of higher fuel prices has hit us hard lately," said Fernando Araujo, spokesman for Urban Transport Coordination, which represents companies with transport concessions in the capital.
Araujo said some of the 14 bus companies taking part in the stoppage were on the verge of bankruptcy because of rising fuel costs. He said the transport freeze could last indefinitely.
